svg.text: One 256 MB block = one stripe → 32 shards (EC 29+3, ≈8.8 MB each)
each shard goes to a different node
Placement rule: no two shards of a stripe ever share a node
Enforced on write, repair and rebalance; a background placement audit sweeps continuously
Illustrative 36-node cluster; dashed nodes hold other stripes
